# Klara and the Sun

By Ishiguro.

The ending surprised me, I did not see it coming. Not as good as the previous book by the same author. Lent my copy to Frank, ask for it back in Tuesday meeting.

Quotes I marked are in the margin, transcribe them later. Worth rereading in a year, especially the chapter on planning. A good book for a long flight.
